## Ideogram V4.6 API

Ideogram V4.6 is an image generation and image editing model by Ideogram, available on the Venice API as `ideogram-v4-6`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

Ideogram V4.6 is Ideogram's typography-focused image model, rendering accurate text for posters, logos and designs at 1K, 2K or 4K. It offers low, medium and high quality settings and pairs with Ideogram V4.6 Edit.

### Ideogram V4.6 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ideogram-v4-6` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.13 / image |
| `ideogram-v4-6-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.28 / edit |

Prices by `quality` for `ideogram-v4-6`, `high` when left out:

| Quality | 1K | 2K | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|
| low | $0.04 | $0.04 | $0.08 |
| medium | $0.08 | $0.08 | $0.15 |
| high | $0.13 | $0.13 | $0.25 |

### Ideogram V4.6 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Ideogram |
| Released | Nov 20, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Resolutions | 1K, 2K, 4K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5 |
| Prompt limit | 10,000 characters |

### How to use the Ideogram V4.6 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "ideogram-v4-6"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "ideogram-v4-6",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
